description: Which SEC form types each of up to 200 companies filed in the last N months (default 24), as a count per form, in ONE call. Use it to offer only forms a company set actually files (10-K, 10-Q, 20-F, 40-F, 6-K, 8-K, DEF 14A, ...). Amendments count toward their base form (10-K/A is a 10-K). A company that cannot be read comes back `readable: false` with no forms, never 'files nothing', and `reason` says why: `unknown_ticker` (no company matches), `not_on_plan` (a real company outside your plan), `unresolved` (a possible share-class ticker, or one more than one company has held: pass the CIK) or `read_failed` (could not look; retry). Available on all plans.

months.description: Look-back window in months. Defaults to 24.

name: list_filing_forms

_meta.description: Response metadata (provenance, point-in-time flag, freshness, request id and warnings). Every field is documented once in the agent contract (agent_contract.meta in the server's manifest.json).

reason.description: Present only when readable is false: no company matches, a company outside the plan, a possible share-class ticker or one more than one company has held (pass the CIK), or a failed read (retry).

title: Filed Form Types
